manifest_binding: The future committed Phase-56 runner must pin this manifest's commit, Git blob OID, SHA-256, and byte length. The manifest intentionally does not contain a self-referential future commit hash.

scope.question: At the single saved phi_plus fine-forward lambda=0.5 root, does replaying the Phase-53 saddle-and-launch algorithm from the pinned Phase-50 saddle recover the saved Phase-53 endpoint residual under both frozen solver profiles, and how do center choice, Hessian-derived launch choice, their interaction, and solver-profile sensitivity contribute?
computed: one fresh Phase-53-algorithm saddle solve at lambda=0.5 from the pinned Phase-50 saddle, using the coherent Phase-53 element-local long action/gradient/Hessian evaluator
one static Newton prediction at the pinned Phase-50 saddle, delta_s_N=-H_real^{-1} g_real, compared descriptively with the fresh solver displacement

two Hessian-derived launch frames, one evaluated at the pinned Phase-50 center and one at the fresh-solved center, with the same frozen mobility, factor, chart, radius, shape, root parameters, and flow time
a fixed 2 x 2 center/launch factorial with corners P50/P50, P50/fresh, fresh/P50, and fresh/fresh
eight ordered EL_long state-only DOP853 integrations: four factorial corners under the primary profile followed by the same four corners under the refined diagnostic profile
five fixed returned fractions per attempt, saved-endpoint comparisons, full scaled-residual vectors and identities, the real-T component, center and launch main effects, and the nonlinear interaction
not_computed: a Gamma--K root solve, Gamma--K continuation, continuation replay, tangent, finite-difference Jacobian, reflection, endpoint mutation, action ledger, first-cap ledger, evaluator schedule comparison, or EL_std ODE
another source, lambda, root, saddle branch, radius, shape, flow time, solver method, or favorable solver-profile selection
an exact byte reconstruction of the unavailable historical Phase-53 saddle, factor, launch, initial-xi, or intermediate trajectory states

a full Phase-56 semantic replay, straight-arm or cap-reintersection search, root/component/end exhaustion, Stokes analysis, determinant line, original cycle, global signed sum, cutoff/continuum limit, physics claim, or theory of everything
scope.historical_boundary: Phase 51 and Phase 53 retain their historical INCONCLUSIVE classifications. Phase 55 remains a valid P50-saddle-pinned reconstruction NONPASS. A recovery classification may qualify only a fresh-algorithm center-and-launch policy as a candidate for a separately frozen later full replay; it does not itself perform or authorize that replay.

pin_validation.recursive_source: Recursively flatten every pinned input declared by the Phase-55 manifest and all of its ancestors, then add the Phase-55 manifest, runner, and result exactly once.
pin_validation.strict_parse: Reject duplicate keys, NaN, Infinity, overflow-to-nonfinite numbers, schema drift, classification drift, self-digest drift, and conflicting declarations for the same path.
pin_validation.commit_blob_policy: For every recursively consumed artifact require the working blob OID, declared Git blob OID, and named commit:path blob OID to agree. Require the Phase-56 runner commit to descend from the commit that first records this frozen manifest and require the runner's working bytes to equal its named commit blob at start and end.
pin_validation.post_rehash: Rehash all 29 consumed paths plus this manifest and the future committed runner after every numerical evaluation and before classification.
pin_validation.volatile_identity_policy: Do not copy or serialize historical process-local id(...) values. Bind evaluators by source labels, roles, generated-source hashes, DAG hashes, exact expression identities, and explicit consumers.

selected_lambda_half_contract.canonicalization: For selected JSON subtrees use strict parse followed by json.dumps(sort_keys=true,separators=(',',':'),ensure_ascii=false,allow_nan=false), UTF-8. Phase-53 and Phase-55 array values remain authoritative binary64 JSON values; no unavailable precision may be invented.

phase55_baseline_contract.primary_relation_projection: Select the lambda=0.5 EL_long saved-endpoint and scaled-residual records into a canonical object with keys saved_endpoint and scaled_residual.
phase55_baseline_contract.primary_p50_initial_xi_digest_policy: Reconstruct the P50 launch by the frozen formula, cast once to a fresh C-contiguous numpy.complex128 array, and hash exactly ndarray.tobytes(order='C').

required_runtime_contract.comparison: Require exact equality to the corresponding fields in the pinned Phase-55 result /runtime record before any numerical evaluation.

baseline_reproduction_thresholds.all_five_physical_states_metric: For every ordered fraction use ||z_Phase56-z_Phase55||_2/max(||z_Phase55||_2,1e-30); Phase55 is always the directed reference.

algorithm.entrypoint: Phase51 SourceContext.saddle with the Phase53 CompleteElementLocalEvaluator installed as the context evaluator
algorithm.initial_candidate: the pinned Phase-50 phi_plus lambda=0.5 saddle
algorithm.jacobian: analytic real part of the coherent Phase53 element-local long Hessian

launch_gates.factor_inverse_identity: Retain factor@factor_inverse and factor_inverse@factor identity residuals as diagnostics only; neither substitutes for the inherited factor-mobility gate.
launch_gates.factor_and_factor_inverse_cross_center_p: Require exact array equality between the P50 and fresh nodes because the frozen mobility factor is saddle-independent.
launch_gates.classification_applicability: Failure of a correctly reconstructed fresh launch selects P56_FRESH_SADDLE_OR_LAUNCH_RECONSTRUCTION_NONPASS. Any P50 launch drift from the pinned Phase-55 launch or initial-xi digest is exclusively a Phase-55 baseline/provenance failure and cannot select the fresh-launch classification.

fresh_saddle_and_launch_contract.historical_summary_comparison: Retain differences from the pinned Phase-53 saddle summary but do not require unavailable saddle-byte identity. Solver source, options, evaluator source/DAG bindings, accepted gates, and call topology are exact requirements; the old summary is an observed comparison.

launch_common.mobility_factor: the same lambda=0.5 factor for both centers; it depends on the frozen mobility path, not on the saddle
launch_common.chart_direction: the same direction from saved root parameters[9:17] for both launches
launch_common.launch_rule: Phase51 deterministic oriented Hessian-xi eigenframe, signed negative/positive blocks, Procrustes alignment, determinant repair, and shape exponent 1

retained_comparisons: cosine when both norms are nonzero
gradient at P50, predicted point, and fresh solved point
newton_prediction.causal_boundary: The Newton comparison is descriptive and cannot by itself select recovery or dominance.

factorial_contract.corner_definition: A center chooses node.saddle_w. A launch chooses the Hessian-derived launch coefficient factor_inverse@launch_w and therefore the initial xi. All corners use the same factor, root chart direction, radius, flow time, scales, EL_long RHS, and endpoint cap target.
factorial_contract.effect_policy: Retain full complex vectors, norms, maximum components, scaled-residual effects, and T components. Do not introduce a post-observation dominance threshold or label one effect as causal from magnitude alone.

refined_diagnostic.role: predeclared sensitivity diagnostic; never selected as a favorable replacement

ode_contract.solver_boundary: Each callback retains clongdouble through state materialization and complete EL_long RHS, then casts the completed RHS once to complex128. Each initial xi is cast once to a fresh C-contiguous complex128 buffer.
ode_contract.completion: Every attempt must return all five requested t_eval values, report success, have callback count equal to nfev, retain finite values, and keep every returned xi norm strictly below 40. No event or tangent integration is allowed.

residual_and_gate_contract.gating_dtype_policy: The target gate and every saved/corner residual comparison must reproduce the Phase-55 complex128 subtraction and float64 scale division exactly. clongdouble diagnostics may be retained separately but cannot replace or select any gate.
residual_and_gate_contract.saved_residual_vector: recompute the same full vector from the pinned saved Phase-53 endpoint and verify its maximum equals the pinned saved scalar under the baseline scalar threshold

profile_stability.gate_policy: For every corner, the ordered three-gate Boolean vector and corner_target_pass must be identical under primary and refined_diagnostic. P50/P50 must remain target-NONPASS under both profiles.
profile_stability.endpoint_cross_profile_metric: ||z_refined-z_primary||_2/max(||z_primary||_2,1e-30), with primary as the directed reference
profile_stability.scaled_residual_cross_profile_metric: max(abs(r_refined-r_primary)) using the declared complex128-gated interleaved residual vectors
profile_stability.selection_policy: Refined values are reported but never substituted for primary values.

residual_and_gate_contract.T_component_ledger: Retain endpoint difference, residual difference, and identity terms for physical component index 8, real and imaginary parts, including the frozen scales5[8] value and whether either T component attains the maximum absolute residual difference.
residual_and_gate_contract.exact_decimal_policy: Use Decimal(str(value)) or retained full-precision decimal strings for every material threshold and reported maximum comparison. Do not relax a threshold after observation.

classification_rules.INVALID_RUN: Any provenance, schema, finite-number, exact topology, evaluator binding, root-call topology, formula, convention, self-digest, or required null-boundary failure.
classification_rules.P56_FRESH_SADDLE_OR_LAUNCH_RECONSTRUCTIO: The correctly pinned fresh saddle solve or fresh Hessian-derived launch is finite but fails a declared scientific saddle/launch gate; retain all eight ODE slots as causally linked placeholders. P50 launch drift instead selects the baseline/provenance rule.
classification_rules.P56_PHASE55_P50_BASELINE_NOT_REPRODUCED: The primary P50/P50 corner does not reproduce the pinned Phase-55 launch, five physical states, endpoint, residual vector/scalars, nfev, and three-gate vector under the frozen baseline thresholds.
classification_rules.P56_FACTORIAL_ODE_COMPLETION_OR_FLOW_NOR: At least one correctly constructed factorial/profile ODE does not complete all five fractions or violates the strict xi-norm cap.
classification_rules.P56_LAMBDA_HALF_GATE_SOLVER_PROFILE_UNST: At least one corner has a different ordered target-gate Boolean vector or corner_target_pass, exceeds either frozen endpoint/residual cross-profile difference threshold, or violates the requirement that P50/P50 remains target-NONPASS under both profiles.
classification_rules.P56_FRESH_PHASE53_ALGORITHM_LAUNCH_RECOV: All prior prerequisites pass, P50/P50 is target-NONPASS under both profiles, and fresh/fresh passes all three unchanged target gates under both profiles.
classification_rules.P56_FRESH_PHASE53_ALGORITHM_LAUNCH_DOES_: All prior prerequisites pass and the stable fresh/fresh corner does not pass all three unchanged target gates under both profiles.
classification_rules.no_mixed_corner_precedence: The two mixed corners are retained for decomposition and profile stability but cannot independently select recovery.

check_contract.status_policy: Exact structural checks use PASS/FAIL and any exact FAIL makes INVALID_RUN. Numerical checks use PASS/NONPASS with explicit applicability. Recovery and nonrecovery are both valid bounded outcomes under classification precedence.

preenumerated_record_topology.factorial_effect_record_definition: Two profiles times center, launch, and interaction; every record carries both endpoint-vector and residual-vector effects plus their reconstruction identities.
preenumerated_record_topology.authoritative_solve_ivp_call_count: exactly 8 when the phase-wide fresh saddle/launch prerequisite passes, otherwise 0 with all eight ODE attempt slots retained as typed placeholders
preenumerated_record_topology.deterministic_orders: center_order, launch_order, corner_order, profile_order, attempt_order, and fraction_order are exactly those declared above. No failed or inapplicable record is omitted.

execution_environment.python: CPython 3.13.5 from uv.lock/.venv; require exact equality to the pinned Phase-55 runtime record
execution_environment.numpy_scipy_sympy_mpmath: NumPy 2.5.2, SciPy 1.18.0, SymPy 1.14.0, mpmath 1.3.0 from the locked repository environment
execution_environment.extended_precision: numpy.longdouble itemsize 16 bytes, numpy.clongdouble itemsize 32 bytes, 63 explicit mantissa bits, epsilon 1.084202172485504434e-19; require exact equality to Phase 55
execution_environment.heavy_run_guard: Run authoritative and independent reproduction through proxmox-scratch with the required thread environment. Validate-only mode must execute zero root solves and zero ODEs.
